['T\u00dcV Rheinland AG '].company_description: TÜV Rheinland is an internationally active, independent service company from Germany that tests, inspects, and certifies technical systems, facilities, and objects of all kinds in order to minimize hazards and prevent damages. It is part of the TÜV Rheinland Group, which is one of the three large holding companies along with TÜV Nord and TÜV SÜD, and also includes smaller independent companies such as TÜV Thüringen, TÜV Saarland, and TÜV Austria.
